decisions.statement: Which checks a round covers is handed in rather than read off disk.
A round is judged at the commit handed in rather than at the head the tree holds.
A round underway satisfies a request where its commit is the one asked or a descendant.
A round underway at any other commit satisfies no part of that request.
A request a round underway satisfies and covers attaches to that round.
A request naming a check no round underway covers opens a round over those checks alone.
A request a round underway covers in part attaches for that part and opens a round for the rest.
More than one round is underway at one commit.
A request is answered by every round it attached to together with the round it opened.
An answer carries the checks the request named and no others.
A check two rounds both answer is carried once.
Rounds are held apart by the commit they answer for.
A round that ended is taken out, and the rounds beside it are left underway.
A round that ended is held no longer, so the round after it starts afresh.
A round handed no check covers the checks the audit phase names.
A round reads the verdicts it had before the checks are judged.
A check whose input never moved is carried onto this commit before any job.
A check carried that way is asked of the cluster by nothing.
A check with no verdict yet is carried nowhere and is asked for.
A check whose verdict is at this commit already is carried nowhere.
The tree is walked once for the carrying rather than once for each check.
A round reads them again once the cluster has answered.
What is newly refusing is the difference between those two readings.
A check with no verdict after the round is left out rather than written over.
Nothing here judges a check, so no verdict is written here.
A round whose checks all answered as before tells nobody.
One message carries every check that turned in a round.
A round the cluster would not take is carried back as a refusal of the round.
A caller may put a sending of its own in place of the one that writes a message.

definition: a round judged in the cluster, and what turned red told to whoever champions checks
